entry_points.title: V3 Red Truck depth-guided GPS attempt
entry_points.question: Can the V3 Red Truck's depth-guided controller reach the End Position GPS within a bounded low-speed operation?
entry_points.finding: The operation timed out without reaching the target. Ground-plane target distance fell from 77.857 m to 68.520 m, and the position-derived path and center-of-mass displacement were 10.175 m and 10.125 m. The terminal sample reported a clear scan, 8 m minimum corridor clearance…

entry_points.title: Repeated V2 color-zone waypoint baseline
entry_points.question: Can the V2 Blue Utility Truck repeatedly reach the four color-zone GPS targets and return to Safe Spawn on the open proving-ground platform using bounded wheel guidance?
entry_points.finding: All ten color-zone legs completed inside the configured 3 m ground-plane radius. Across them, the receipts report about 634.689 m of position-sampled path and 626.823 m of center-of-mass displacement over 39,402 simulation ticks (656.7 nominal seconds). Terminal physics speed…
